recipe.visualDefinition: A high-glamour, tight-crop portrait of a woman with voluminous blonde hair, featuring hyper-realistic crystalline or diamond-like tears streaming down her cheeks. The lighting is soft and ethereal, emphasizing smooth skin textures and sparkling highlights within the tears.
coreVisualRelationships: The contrast between the organic softness of the skin/hair and the hard, refractive brilliance of the diamond tears.
The upward gaze of the subject creating a sense of vulnerability and hope.
The framing effect of the wild, textured hair against the smooth facial features.
coreInvariants: Diamond-like refractive tears with internal light glints.
Voluminous, messy-yet-styled blonde hair surrounding the face.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up, face centered but tilted slightly, occupying 80% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The eyes and the primary diamond tear on the right cheek.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the eyes downward along the tear tracks, then outward to the surrounding hair texture.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is filled with hair and facial features.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm beige and honey-blonde tones in the skin and hair.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep brown and black in the eyelashes and pupils.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cool white and prismatic glints within the crystalline tears.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low to medium saturation with a high-key value range, emphasizing luminosity.

composition.position: Top right and bottom right margins

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-family weight variation for a clean, modern look.

candidateDirections.reason: Clean geometric structure matches the modern aesthetic.
Professional, balanced weight for vertical stacking.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-resolution beauty portrait of a woman with voluminous blonde hair looking upward. Add digital effects for liquid tears that transition into sparkling diamonds or crystals.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add vertical, all-caps geometric sans-serif text in white along the right edge, rotated 90 degrees.

verificationChecks: Skin texture is smooth but retains natural pores.
Hair fills the corners of the frame.

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the diamond tears look integrated into the skin, not just floating.
Check that the vertical text does not obscure the eyes.
Verify the hair texture is detailed and not a solid mass.
Confirm the color palette remains in the warm-neutral range.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine high-fashion beauty photography with surrealist jewelry-inspired elements and minimalist vertical typography.
